Necrotic Resistance is one of the Defenses which mitigates Necrotic Damage during Combat Calculations.

## Contents

- 1 Value

- 2 Calculations

- 2.1 Shred

- 2.2 Base mitigation

- 2.3 Enemy penetration

## Value[]

Necrotic Resistance is a percentage value with no upper limit.

By calculations, it is negatively affected by Shred and natural enemy penetration. It is possible for Necrotic Resistance to go negative, increasing incoming necrotic damage.

{\displaystyle TotalResistance=\min(75\%,\%_{Resistance}-5\%*n_{ShredStacks})-n_{zoneLevel}\%}

### Shred[]

Necrotic Shred stacks reduce Necrotic Resistance by 5% each. It has 60% less effectiveness against players and bosses.

### Base mitigation[]

Up to 75% of resistance is used for base mitigation, any leftover portion is ignored.

### Enemy penetration[]

Enemies naturally penetrate 1% of resistance per area level, up to 75%.
